title: Add `coldboot` parameter to JSON-RPC interface of daemon
body:
The coldboot parameter can be used for android based emulators to
force a full boot.

The JSON-RPC interface does not provide means to cold boot android based emulators. This option was recently added using the command line interface. This pull request extends the JSON-RPC interface for cold boot launch.

Note: This PR changes the version of the daemon from 0.6.0 to 0.6.1, the change is fully backwards compatible.

This PR implements the following feature request #83471 

closes #83471
